up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for reactions catalyzed by UGT1A10. Include the substrate canonical SMILES structure, the substrate compound name, the parent compound name, the metabolic conversion description, the pathway key, and the organism.
sql:
SELECT
  cs_sub.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure,
  cr_sub.compound_name AS substrate_name,
  cr_drug.compound_name AS parent_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key,
  m.organism
FROM metabolism m
JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs_sub ON md_sub.molregno = cs_sub.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_drug ON m.drug_record_id = cr_drug.record_id
WHERE m.enzyme_name = 'UGT1A10'
LIMIT 200;
